purpose: Teach: 短縮/共存/退院/各自/待機/早起き/仲介/専業

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 会議時間、本気で、絶対、短縮、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Shorten meeting times. I'm serious about this—non-negotiable. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding. Direct eye contact. No softening. Clipped rhythm. The tone of someone used to being obeyed, but not unkind about it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新旧システム、本気で、絶対、共存、絶対、運用、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're managing the old and new systems in parallel. Thank you for your clear direction.
lines.style: Measured, professional. A slight bow of the head on the affirmative. Steady pace, careful enunciation. The tone of someone taking notes mentally, making sure he gets it right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 入院した田中さんの、本気で、絶対、退院、絶対、状況、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Follow up on Tanaka's status. Find out when he can return to work.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful. Slightly softer than the first line—this one carries a note of actual concern beneath the directness. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人研修、本気で、絶対、各自、絶対、進捗、絶対、把握しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The new hire training is on track. We're monitoring everyone's progress closely.
lines.style: Calm, reassuring. Slightly quicker pace than the previous line. A small nod. The tone of someone delivering good news and wanting it to land clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 非常時、本気で、絶対、待機、絶対、人員、絶対、確保しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In case of emergency, secure adequate personnel on standby. Make it happen.
lines.style: Firm, no-nonsense. A short pause after 'emergency' for weight. Lower register, deliberate. The underlying seriousness of the request comes through without raising volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、早起き、絶対、推奨、絶対、社内、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're encouraging our team to maintain earlier schedules. Everything is proceeding as planned.
lines.style: Polished, formal. A touch of pride in the delivery—he's communicating competence. Even rhythm, clear articulation. The tone of reporting progress to someone whose approval matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 取引、本気で、絶対、仲介、絶対、業者、絶対、選定しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Select vendors carefully for our partnerships. Choose well.
lines.style: Weighted, deliberate. A slight pause before 'carefully'—this matters. Lower pitch, careful diction. The tone of someone who knows that one bad vendor choice ripples outward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、専業、絶対、希望、絶対、調整しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood, sir. We're reviewing staff preferences for full-time positions and making adjustments accordingly.
lines.style: Professional, slightly warmer than earlier responses. A sense of completion in the delivery—this feels like the final item on a list. Clear, confident pacing.
